global: Read and follow repository AGENTS.md before edits.
Do not change canonical security semantics to improve experiment results.
Implementation and generated-evidence commits are separate.
Every experiment has a manifest, raw output, summary, checksum, rerun command, and claim boundary.
Unavailable and failed cells remain visible.
All deterministic outputs are reproducible from a clean tree.
python scripts/validate.py passes before final integration, unless an unavailable external dependency is explicitly documented.
No secrets, API keys, access tokens, or private model credentials are retained in evidence.
scaling: Historical 1,462,607 raw trace result remains exactly reproducible.
Historical canonical-state anchor remains 31 unless a documented semantic correction intentionally changes the representation.
Every supported safe/unsafe fixture has semantically agreeing verdicts across independent backends.
Every reduced unsafe witness lifts/replays against the original model.
mutations: At least 20 non-duplicate mutants across at least four property families.
All deliberately unsafe retained mutants are detected by all backends that claim support.
Each mutant has a stable ID and expected property violation.
provenance_precision: All ITES conditions use the same action authorisation rule.
Authenticated-contributor condition never ignores an actual contributor.
Ground-truth labels are derived deterministically from ACS/provenance fixtures.
agentdojo: Final selected model has meaningful benign competence on the frozen subset.
Upstream task IDs and native metrics are preserved.
No benchmark-specific evaluator shortcut is added.
Malicious proposal and unauthorised executed effect are separate metrics.
Raw traces are retained or referenced according to repository privacy/size policy.
planning: All planning modes execute through the same action-time security kernel.
Generated code is not executed in the research comparison.
Task success criteria are planner-mode independent.
Policy/argument changes invalidate or re-authorise plans as designed.
